job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled GenAI Engineer with 4+ years of experience to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions for real-world business applications.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering production-ready GenAI projects, with expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI solutions.
The role involves building scalable AI applications on Azure and Databricks, integrating enterprise data into AI workflows, developing APIs, optimizing AI performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and secure AI-powered solutions.

Location - Remote, Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Hyderabad
